The draft explanation for Q34 passes. Choices 1–4 are correct and choice 5 is incorrect, which matches the official answer of 5. The choice 3 explanation (smart grid) is a general definition, so I didn't check it against a primary source.

The e-Gov text of the Energy Conservation Act is the only source I read in full. The Agency for Natural Resources and Energy site returned 403 each time I tried to fetch it, so the checks on cogeneration and S+3E rely on search-result snippets from official pages. The ESCO PDF couldn't be extracted either, so that check also relies on a snippet.

Some claude.ai connectors (Microsoft 365, Slack, Vercel, Zapier) need to be authorized in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. They weren't needed for this review.
